disable.cppcoreguidelines-avoid-non-const-global: the injected DLL keeps its hook originals and state in g_ and o_ globals, named by CLAUDE.md
disable.cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-reinterpret-c: the DLL binds msedge.dll by RVA and reads fields at reversed offsets, so every Edge pointer is a reinterpret_cast
disable.performance-no-int-to-ptr: the DLL binds msedge.dll by RVA, so every Edge function is an integer-to-pointer cast
disable.bugprone-multi-level-implicit-pointer-co: the Edge bindings go through raw offsets and pointer-to-pointer fields
disable.cert-dcl50-cpp: Log() is a printf-style variadic on purpose
disable.modernize-avoid-variadic-functions: Log() is a printf-style variadic on purpose
disable.bugprone-unchecked-string-to-number-conv: the callers check the parsed value's range themselves

optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.ConstexprV: offsets.h names each RVA and field offset after the reversed symbol (PascalCase or Class_Method) so it greps against the PDB and docs/re
optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.FunctionIg: hook detours are h_ on purpose, and wmain is the entry point's own name
optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.GlobalVari: hook detours are h_ and their originals o_ on purpose
optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.TypeAliasI: function-pointer aliases are named after the Edge function they bind, with a _t suffix
optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.TypedefIgn: function-pointer aliases are named after the Edge function they bind, with a _t suffix
optionReasons.readability-identifier-naming.StaticVari: a function-local static is named like a local; g_ marks the globals and CLAUDE.md has no file-static prefix
optionReasons.readability-function-size.NestingThresho: the hook table, the injected page scripts (raw string literals) and the resolve and split-command sequences are long by design; the Win32 callbacks take the parameters the API defines
optionReasons.readability-function-size.ParameterThres: the hook table, the injected page scripts (raw string literals) and the resolve and split-command sequences are long by design; the Win32 callbacks take the parameters the API defines
optionReasons.readability-function-size.LineThreshold: the hook table, the injected page scripts (raw string literals) and the resolve and split-command sequences are long by design; the Win32 callbacks take the parameters the API defines
optionReasons.readability-function-size.StatementThres: the hook table, the injected page scripts (raw string literals) and the resolve and split-command sequences are long by design; the Win32 callbacks take the parameters the API defines
optionReasons.readability-function-cognitive-complexit: Decide and Run are the two decision tables of the resolver and measure 33 and 34
optionReasons.bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters.Min: rect and point helpers take their coordinates as adjacent ints
optionReasons.readability-magic-numbers.IgnoredInteger: Edge struct sizes and padding mirror the reversed layouts, and the nibble, channel and decimal-digit masks name themselves
optionReasons.readability-magic-numbers.IgnoredFloatin: halving and doubling a layout weight

disable.google-build-using-namespace: a test uses the namespace it exercises
disable.readability-function-size: a test file lists its cases in one RunChecks function
